name: Consumer home robots
title: Consumer home robots after Anki and Jibo: still a no-go
question: Are consumer home robots viable again after Anki and Jibo?
answer: Anki, maker of the Cozmo and Vector robots, went bankrupt in April 2019 after losing a critical funding round. Jibo, a social home robot co-founded in 2012, was also gone by then. Hardware with thin margins needs patient capital and a reason to keep using the robot after the novelty fades. Neither constraint has measurably moved.
verdict_reason: Neither the capital constraint nor the engagement problem has measurably changed.

constraint.name: Hardware margins and lasting use
constraint.detail: Consumer robots sell on novelty, cost real money to build and support, and struggle to stay in daily use.
